spans.s: हल् vi. 1P (pp. हलित; pres. हलति) To plough.
हल n. A plough, वहसि वपुषि विशदे वसन जलदाभम् । हलहतिभीतिमिलितयमुनाभम् केशवधृतहलधररूप Git.G.i.
हला (I) f. 1. A female friend; 2. the earth; 3. water; 4. spirituous liquor.
हला (II) ind. A vocative particle used in addressing a female friend (in theatrical language), हला भएण विसुमरिदम्हि Ve.ii.
हाल m. 1. A plough; 2. a name of Balarāma; 3. a name of Śālivāhana (of Śātavāhana according to some).
हालहली f. Wine, spirituous liquor, हित्वा हालामभिमतरसां रेवतीलोचनांकाम् Megh.i.49.
हल-आयुध m. an epithet of Balarāma.
हल-भूति f. agriculture.
हल-भृत् m. 1. a ploughman; 2. Balarāma, अंसन्यस्ते सति हलभृतो मेचके वाससीव Megh.i.59.
हाल-भृत् m. an epithet of Balarāma.
हल-भृति f. ploughing, agriculture.
हल-हति f. ploughing, furrowing.
हलहला f. Halloo, hallooing.
हलाहल m.n. 1. A sort of deadly poison produced at the churning of the ocean; 2. a poison in general. (Written also हालहल and हालाहल.)

हाल(ला)हल n. 1. A sort of deadly poison produced at the churning of the ocean and quaffed by Śiva, अहमेव गुरुः सुदारुणानामिति हालाहल तात मास्म दृप्यः K.Pr.x.; 2. poison in general, Bh.V.i.95. (Also हालहाल.)

हाल(ला)हल n. 1. A sort of deadly poison produced at the churning of the ocean and quaffed by Śiva, अहमेव गुरुः सुदारुणानामिति हालाहल तात मास्म दृप्यः K.Pr.x.; 2. poison in general, Bh.V.i.95. (Also हालहाल.)
हलि m. 1. A large plough; 2. agriculture.
हाली f. A wife’s younger sister.
हलिन् m. 1. A ploughman, a cultivator; 2. a name of Balarāma.
हलिन्-प्रिय m. the kadamba tree.
हलिन्-प्रिया f. spirituous liquor.
हलिनी f. A number of ploughs.
हालिनी f. A sort of large lizard.
हलीन m. The teak tree.
हलीशा f. The handle of a plough.
हल्लीश(ष) n. 1. One of the 18 minor dramatic entertainments; (it is described as consisting mainly of singing and dancing by one male and a number of female performers); 2. a circular dance.
हल्लीश(ष) n. 1. One of the 18 minor dramatic entertainments; (it is described as consisting mainly of singing and dancing by one male and a number of female performers); 2. a circular dance.
हल्य a. (f. ल्या) 1. Arable; 2. ugly.
हल्य a. (f. ल्या) 1. Arable; 2. ugly.
हल्या f. A multitude of ploughs.
हल्लक n. The red lotus.
हालक m. A horse of a yellowish-brown colour.
हल्लन n. Rolling or tossing about.
हल्लीशक m. Dancing in a ring.
हालहली f. Wine, spirituous liquor, हित्वा हालामभिमतरसां रेवतीलोचनांकाम् Megh.i.49.
हालिक m. 1. A ploughman, an agriculturist; 2. a plough-ox.
हालु m. A tooth.
